info.description: Allows users to run mods and connect to unchained servers. Required for modded play and self-hosted servers.
info.name: Unchained Core Plugin

releases.release_notes_markdown:
## User-facing changes

- **Mod loading:** automatically discover and register mounted mod maps and assets. Custom map loading screens now use mod-provided markers and map metadata instead of a hard-coded list.
- **Commands and voting:** add a shared command system for game chat, console, RCON, and Discord, with case-insensitive command names and built-in help. Server votes cover map changes, ending the current map, bots, game speed, modifiers, and server restarts.
- **Chat and announcements:** add join/leave and map-change announcements, killstreak messages, and Discord chat relay. Fix empty MOTDs, multiline chat parsing, duplicated relay messages, and broadcast sender formatting.
- **Connection stability:** prevent an unused Steam authentication ticket allocation that could cause frontend EOS login hangs after repeated launches. Guard PlayFab logout cleanup after session teardown.
- **Gameplay stability:** reduce offline gameplay stutters by disabling online-stat updates. Add recursion protection and a server camera-mode crash workaround when `--desync-patch` is enabled.
- **Console and logs:** restore client console input, improve scrolling and text selection, and make chat channels and senders easier to distinguish. Fix banner rendering under Wine and suppress unsupported emoji in legacy graphical consoles.
- **Startup reliability:** handle signature-scanning failures more clearly and harden Unreal memory access, mod actor spawning, and game-thread job execution.

## Integrator-facing changes

- **Server-browser registration:** add registration, metadata updates, and heartbeats directly in the plugin, including active mod metadata. Re-register after rejected updates or heartbeats, retry transient failures with backoff, and exclude the headless host from player counts.
  - Registration is opt-in: supply `--register` on server launches. Server-only behavior is selected by the presence of `--rcon`.
  - Reuse the startup mod scan rather than scanning again on every registration attempt.
- **IPv6:** add client IPv6 support and opt-in IPv6 registration transport with `--use-ipv6`. `--local-ip` controls the advertised address; IPv6 registration requires an IPv6-reachable backend. See [configuration](https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/blob/v1.0.0/README.md#configuration).
- **Mod packaging:** support `DA_ModMarker_V2`, `DA_MapMarker_V2`, and direct merging of a pak's `ModAssetRegistry.bin`. Retain V1 marker support and fall back to cooked-header discovery when registry data is absent or rejected. Registration runs in game-thread batches controlled by `--mod-map-batch`. See [mod loading](https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/blob/v1.0.0/docs/mod_loading_branch.md).
- **Configuration overrides:** support command-line `-ini:` values and profile-based INI overrides for mod content, keyed by map name and map-rotation index.
- **Logging configuration:** replace the old logger and `--unchained-log-level` setting with log4rs. Load `--log4rs-yaml`, then working-directory `log4rs.yaml`, then embedded defaults. Invalid custom configuration reports an error and falls back to defaults after five seconds.
  - Default files are `unchained.log`, `chat.log`, and `kismet.log` under the launch's `Saved_<suffix>/Logs` directory.
  - Add configurable targets, patterns, named color palettes, and JSON-lines output. Chat records expose channel, sender, source, kind, label, and faction attributes. See [logging](https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/blob/v1.0.0/docs/logging.md).
- **Launcher/process integration:** add `--attach-stdio` for inherited streams or the parent console, and independent `--no-spawn-console` control. Calling programs provide pipes or redirection; JSON output uses log4rs encoders.
- **Discord integration:** add configurable channels and role-based command permissions. Move outbound delivery off the event bus, batch event logs, coalesce dashboard updates, and report rate-limit waits and delivery delays. Queues are bounded and non-durable; messages can be dropped under overload or on shutdown. See [delivery behavior](https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/blob/v1.0.0/docs/discord-delivery.md).
- **Diagnostics and metadata:** redact passwords, bot tokens, and potentially sensitive launch arguments in CLI diagnostics. Embed `1.0.0` in plugin build metadata and Windows DLL version resources; invalidate cached resolver data on plugin-version changes.

## Contributor-facing changes

- Migrate the plugin from the mixed C++/Rust implementation to a Rust-only Cargo workspace; remove the legacy CMake, hook, patch, and logging implementations.
- Add discoverable Rust hooks, patches, and platform-aware resolvers, with explicit native pointer types and safer Unreal object, string, array, and allocator access.
- Introduce typed event and broadcast buses, permission-aware command handlers, extensible vote types, and shared rich-text rendering. See [contributing](https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/blob/v1.0.0/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- Add a mock server, `cargo xtask` build/install tooling, VS Code and RustRover configurations, and regression tests for commands, votes, logging, Discord delivery, mod discovery, and configuration parsing.
- Pin the Rust toolchain and lock dependencies. CI builds and tests debug/release profiles, validates plugin metadata, requires DLL artifacts, and shares profile-specific caches. Tagged releases build and test the DLL before publication and request registry registration through shared community workflows.

Compared with **v0.5.0**, the last release before the 1.0 prereleases; includes changes across all 1.0 RCs.

[Full source comparison: v0.5.0...v1.0.0](https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/compare/v0.5.0...v1.0.0)

releases.release_notes_markdown:
## What's Changed
* Move Discord event-log processing into a background task by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/2
* Harden Unreal allocator access and startup initialization by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/1
* Fix empty MOTD and multiline chat parsing by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/10
* Implement support for INI file config overrides. by @Knutschbert in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/12
* Logging Standardization by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/13
* Restore per-call function prefixes and simplify console labels by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/15
* Decouple Discord delivery from event batching by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/11
* Fix startup banner colors under Wine by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/16
* Forward console output and add --attach-std by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/17
* Ipv6 server support by @Knutschbert in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/19
* Re-register servers after rejected updates or heartbeats by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/18
* Support inline log palette switches by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/21
* Name opaque native hook pointer types by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/23
* Fix startup banner padding and truecolor encoding by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/25
* Mod loading, console interaction, mod loader settings by @Knutschbert in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/24
* Load log4rs.yaml from the working directory by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/26
* Fix Steam ticket leak in Redpoint login probe by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/27
* Fix PlayFab authentication crash during server shutdown by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/32
* Mod Asset Registry loading and V2 mod/map markers by @Knutschbert in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/31
* Finalize logging standardization and nonblocking console selection by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/30
* Consolidate Rust CI caches by build profile by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/40
* Remove unused dependencies while preserving logging features by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/41
* Scan the mod registry once per registration worker and condense V2-marker logging by @Knutschbert in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/39
* Add magenta Client Message column to senderless system logs by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/45

## New Contributors
* @Jacoby6000 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/2
* @Knutschbert made their first contribution in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/12

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/compare/v0.5.0...v1.0.0-rc4

releases.release_notes_markdown:
## What's Changed

* Rewritten events system
  * Voting and other commands are no longer tied to the discord integration.
  * Players in game can vote without the host having to set up discord
* In-game chat now shows when players join and leave
* Improved stability via safer access to critical game internals
* Discord integration now gets an event log
* Discord integration now tracks map changes and server starts
* In-game server messages are now less obnoxious
* Command improvements
  * Commands now always accessible
  * Type `!help` in game or in the related discord channel to see available commands
* Voting improvements
  * Vote speed 
    * Players can vote for game speed by entering `!vote speed <speed-in-percent>`. This allows users to switch to fast speed and slomo
  * Vote restart-server
    * Players can vote to restart the server if they are noticing degraded performance, or think things aren't working right
    
## PRs

* Generalized event system by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/60
* Fix player count by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/61
* Leave events by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/62
* Reconfigurable discord, event log subscriber, enhanced damage events, cleaned up discord cli args by @Jacoby6000 in https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/pull/63


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Chiv2-Community/UnchainedPlugin/compare/v1.0.0-rc0...v1.0.0-RC1
